data.name: recipeUi.calibrationPage.lblGuide.text
data.value:
Calibration hub.
- Each button opens a separate modeless settings window. - BOTTOM COLLET 1:1 CAL corrects the T component to zero for collets 1–4 on the front/rear pickers using the bottom camera. - PICKUP Z CAL lowers PickerZ above the wafer film and saves the position where Vacuum/Flow activates as PickPosition. - PLACE Z CAL lowers PickerZ at the output placement position and saves the position where Vacuum/Flow activates as PlacePosition. - NEEDLE Z CAL calculates NeedleCap Touch, NeedlePin Flush and NeedlePin Ready positions using WaferStageTouchSensor. - VISION CAMERA CAL, VISION FOCUS CAL and SIDE VISION FOCUS CAL run in their dedicated settings windows. - Equipment safety interlocks, phase gates and resource gates are not bypassed.
